reextract.title: Re-extract Face Features
reextract.desc: Re-extract 512D feature vectors for all face photos in the gallery using the currently active algorithm package. This aligns the feature space with updated models and automatically rebuilds the in-memory index.
reextract.singleDesc: Re-extract face feature vectors and aligned crops for "{{name}}" based on original photos?
reextract.inProgress: Extracting features with the active algorithm package, please wait...
reextract.successDesc: Successfully re-extracted features for all {{total}} face photo(s). Memory index updated.
reextract.failedDesc: Task encountered an unexpected error, please check system logs
reextract.partialDesc: Processed {{total}} photo(s): {{succeeded}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed. Failed samples retain existing features.

import.title: Bulk Personnel Import
import.subtitle: Upload an archive; the system extracts face features per person in the background
import.viewReportTooltip: View the result report and failure details of the latest bulk import
import.dropzoneText: Click or drag an archive here
import.dropzoneHint: Supports .zip / .tar.gz / .tar, up to {{maxMb}} MB per archive
import.archiveTooLarge: Archive size exceeds the limit ({{maxMb}} MB). Please split and import in batches.
import.runInBackgroundHint: Closing this window will not interrupt the task; you will be notified on completion
import.templateHint: An optional manifest.csv inside the archive maps all fields; otherwise files are recognised by naming convention
import.guideManifestDesc: Include a manifest.csv listing name, ID, card number, remark and photo file names. Chinese headers and GBK encoding are supported.
import.guideConventionDesc: Without a manifest: single photo as "Name.jpg" or "EmpId_Name.jpg", multiple photos in a "Name/01.jpg" folder.
import.guideTipFace: Each photo must be a clear frontal face; quality score must reach 0.50
import.guideTipLimit: At most 5 photos per person; extras are ignored in file-name order
import.guideTipClean: System files such as __MACOSX, .DS_Store and Thumbs.db are ignored automatically
import.guideTipConflict: Records with duplicate employee IDs or faces matching another subject are skipped and listed in the failure details
import.guideTipSerial: Imports run serially to protect live video analysis performance; please be patient
import.inProgress: Extracting face features and writing to the gallery. Do not shut down the system
import.reportDescCompleted: All {{total}} personnel were enrolled with face features.
import.reportDescPartial: {{succeeded}} of {{total}} personnel succeeded, {{failed}} failed. Fix the photos and import them again.
import.reportDescFailed: All {{total}} personnel failed. Check photo quality and manifest format, then retry.
import.reportDescCancelled: The task was aborted. The {{processed}} processed personnel remain enrolled; unprocessed personnel were not written.
import.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the text manually
import.noAlgorithm: Face recognition is not ready. Deploy or activate a face algorithm package first
import.concurrencyConflict: Another gallery maintenance task is running. Please try again later
import.startFailed: Failed to start the bulk import
import.cancelFailed: Failed to abort the bulk import
import.templateFailed: Failed to download the CSV template
import.completedToastDesc: {{total}} total ({{succeeded}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed). Click to view the report
import.failedToastDesc: The import task did not finish. Click for details
import.cancelledToastDesc: {{succeeded}} enrolled; unprocessed personnel were not written
